title: Initial velocities
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitudes of the velocities of A and B immediately after spring release (4.0 m/s and 1.0 m/s).

title: Conservation application
description: Important: Applies conservation of momentum and energy (or equivalent) to relate the initial velocities and total kinetic energy.

title: Which stops first
description: Essential: Correctly identifies block B as the one that comes to rest first.

title: Stopping time analysis
description: Important: Uses kinematics or impulse to compare stopping times, correctly finding B's time is shorter.

title: Distance at first stop
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance between A and B when B first stops (0.50 m).

title: Post-collision velocities
description: Important: Correctly applies elastic collision equations to find velocities after A rebounds from the wall and collides with B.

title: Final separation distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final distance between A and B after both stop (0.91 m).

title: Work-energy for displacements
description: Important: Uses the work-energy theorem or kinematics with friction to find stopping distances.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs for velocities or displacements, especially after collisions or wall rebound.

title: Friction force mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect frictional force (e.g., omits mass or uses static coefficient).
